statements.markdown: **Theorem 4.6 (binary low-degree test; [ABSSW26, Theorem 4.1]).** Let $D=cb^c$ and $q\ge10^6D^3$, and with $K$ as in (11) put $J=2((c+1)K+29)$ and $S=28+J$. If this test rejects $(f,f')$ with probability $\kappa$ and $J\kappa\le1/(4\cdot10^6)$, then some polynomial $P$ of total degree at most $D$ has $\Delta_{\rm full}(f,\mathcal H_r(P))\le S\kappa$ and $\Delta_{\rm hom}(f,\mathcal H_r(P))\le S\kappa$.
statements.section: 4. Low-degree tests over the binary alphabet
